$comment: The schema of every v1 route on the day it shipped (D4). Only ever grows: an entry is added by `npm run api:schema -- --baseline` when a route ships, and no entry is ever edited. lib/api/contract.test.ts fails on any route or field here that the current schema removed or narrowed.

response.description: What this installation is, for a native app before it signs in. Nothing about any person.

items.description: One run of a sentence, with the dictionary entry it was vouched as, if any.

intro.description: What to show the first time this word is met; null on a card already seen.

anyOf.description: A meaning as the learner's language leads it; the English is never dropped while an equivalent leads.

items.description: A meaning as the learner's language leads it; the English is never dropped while an equivalent leads.

scheduling.description: A card's scheduling, as a grade leaves it and as undo puts it back.

items.description: One card of a review sitting, as the web's review session receives it.

nextDue.description: When the next card comes back, on an empty sitting alone; the line is in the learner's language.

waitingOnCourse.description: Whether unseen cards are held back until the course reaches them.

response.description: Today's review sitting: due cards, then a capped trickle of new ones, held to what the course has taught.

id.description: The id the device chose for this answer, before it asked. Sending it twice records it once.

reviewedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds on the device, clamped by the server to the last thirty days and to never after it heard.

slot.description: What the round asked about, where narrower than the card; checked against a closed list.

reachedSlot.description: The form that came back instead, where the round could name one.

spoken.description: True only where the answer marked is what the recognizer heard, word for word.

settled.description: Every id the client may now drop: recorded now, recorded before, or never recordable.

anyOf.description: A card's scheduling, as a grade leaves it and as undo puts it back.

scheduling.description: What this request left the card at, or null where it wrote nothing now.

results.description: One entry per grade written by this request, in the order they were applied.

previous.description: The scheduling the card had before the grade being taken back, as the grade's own answer gave it.

finished.description: True where today's lesson is already done; the next one waits for tomorrow.

final.description: Whether this is the check on the whole of the level.

passed.description: Whether the part after it is open; false until the check is passed.

href.description: The path of today on the web, under the deployment's own address.

response.description: Whether today is a lesson, a check, the web or nothing planned.

cast.description: Who speaks, by name, and the voice each is read in.

sounds.description: Recordings by id, as `GET /api/v1/recordings` names them.

examples.description: Lines of the conversation, by index.

lesson.description: One lesson as the web's lesson screen receives it. Two conventions run through its English, and a native screen draws them as the web's `Braced` does: Estonian inside an English sentence is written in braces, `{mina}`, and is marked as Estonian; a form's name in square brackets, `[osastav] (3rd form)`, is Estonian too and is not a word the lesson teaches. The capital I of "I form" is set in a face where it cannot be read as a lower-case l. The stand-in name Tom in a model answer is replaced by the learner's own `name` after translating. The Estonian was written for a beginner and read by a native speaker; a client draws it as it stands and never joins, respells or builds a line.

accept.description: Every spelling that counts, the asked one first.

items.description: One question, built on the server; the client never decides what a learner is asked.

accept.description: Every spelling that counts, the asked one first.

items.description: One question, built on the server; the client never decides what a learner is asked.

next.description: The next lesson in the same level, or null at its end.

scene.description: The lesson's own conversation, a scene id, where it has one.

name.description: The learner's own first name, for a model answer about them.

due.description: Cards due in the learner's reviews now.

check.description: The check that closes this lesson's part, where this is its last lesson.

translations.description: The lesson's own English in the learner's language, keyed by the English it replaces, for every line a translation exists for; empty in English. The Estonian is never in it and never changes.

response.description: One lesson, as the web's lesson screen receives it.

recorded.description: Whether today's evening was ticked; false for a lesson ahead of today, which records nothing.

items.description: The attempt's questions as the web's check screen receives them, the right answers included, which the web uses for feedback too; the mark is the server's.

accept.description: Every spelling that counts, the asked one first.

items.description: One question, built on the server; the client never decides what a learner is asked.

needed.description: How many marks a pass takes.

response.description: One attempt's paper at a part's check.

attempt.description: The attempt the paper was fetched for; the server builds that paper again to mark it.

responses.description: What was picked or typed for each question, in order; null where nothing was.

response.description: The attempt marked on the server. A right answer is one point and a nearly half.

level.description: Asked of the A1 checks first, as the web's level picker asks: a move up past an unpassed check is refused with `forbidden`.

dailyGoal.description: Clamped to 5 to 200, as the web clamps it.

voice.description: A voice id; one the server does not offer is stored as its default.

speechPace.description: A pace id, or `auto`; anything else is stored as `auto`.

timeZone.description: An IANA zone name; one the server cannot read refuses the whole change.

reminderAt.description: `HH:MM`; a malformed time is clamped to one, never refused.

letters.description: Kinds switched on or off; a kind the server does not send refuses the whole change.

request.description: Some of the settings a phone shows, each normalized as its Settings control normalizes it. Nothing is written unless every field can be.

level.description: The level the course opens at, measured or stated.

dailyGoal.description: Reviews a day that fill the goal ring, 5 to 200.

glossLanguage.description: The language a meaning leads in beside the English.

voice.description: The voice that reads Estonian aloud, by id.

speechPace.description: A pace's id, or `auto` where it follows the level.

sendAtOnce.description: Whether a line the microphone matched is sent without the countdown.

inBoxes.description: Whether the microphone appears in answer boxes.

sceneAnswer.description: How a conversation is answered, or null where never chosen.

timeZone.description: An IANA zone name, or null where the device never said.

roundPace.description: How long a timed round runs, as a pace's id.

reminderAt.description: The evening reminder's time, `HH:MM`, or null where never set.

letters.description: Every kind of letter and notification a learner may switch, and whether it is on.

response.description: Who the token belongs to, and the settings a phone shows.

confirmation.description: The word the learner typed: `delete`, or its Russian or Ukrainian, as Settings asks.

identityErased.description: Whether the sign-in record went too; false on a local install and where the operator holds no key that can.

remaining.description: What is left and who to ask, in English, or null where nothing is.

response.description: The backup the web's export downloads, every table of the learner's own, which the web's restore reads back.

token.description: The registration token Firebase Cloud Messaging gave the app on this phone.

request.description: A phone to remind, registered on every launch so the server knows it was seen. The app build is read off `X-Kodukeel-Build`.

response.description: The phone will be reminded of the kinds its owner left switched on, on no second channel the same day.

token.description: The registration token Firebase Cloud Messaging gave the app on this phone.

request.description: A phone to stop reminding, sent when the learner turns notifications off or signs out.

forgotten.description: Whether this learner had that phone registered.
